We’re proud to see our colleague Maria Santos featured in this wonderful series from the[Saskatoon Open Door Society](https://facebook.com/1615062012090289) . Maria shares her family’s journey to Canada, her experience growing up in Saskatoon and the pride she feels seeing her children embrace their Filipino heritage. Thanks for sharing your story, Maria!
